description_en: Queries the Active Directory (AD) authentication configuration of a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例上AD认证的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-instance-ad-auth-server --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceADAuthServer

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to query.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

Account.description_en: The distinguished name (DN) of the server account

BaseDN.description_en: The Base DN used to connect to the AD server

Domain.description_en: The domain on the AD server

EmailMapping.description_en: The field name that corresponds to the user email address on the AD server
EmailMapping.description_zh: AD服务器上对应的用户邮箱的字段名称

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether a password is set. Valid values:
true: A password is set.
false: No password is set
HasPassword.description_zh:
是否设置密码。取值：
true：设置密码
false：未设置密码

IsDefault.description_en: Indicates whether this is the default AD authentication server. A value of true indicates that it is the default server. A value of false indicates that it is not the default server
IsDefault.description_zh: 是否为默认AD认证服务器。取值：true表示是，false表示否

IsSSL.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL is supported. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
IsSSL.description_zh:
是否支持SSL。取值：

true：是
false：否

IsSyncEmailAttr.description_en: Indicates whether email addresses are synchronized. A value of true indicates that email addresses are synchronized. A value of false indicates that email addresses are not synchronized
IsSyncEmailAttr.description_zh: 是否同步邮箱。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步

IsSyncMobileAttr.description_en: Indicates whether mobile numbers are synchronized. A value of true indicates that mobile numbers are synchronized. A value of false indicates that mobile numbers are not synchronized
IsSyncMobileAttr.description_zh: 是否同步手机号。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步

IsSyncNameAttr.description_en: Indicates whether display names are synchronized. A value of true indicates that display names are synchronized. A value of false indicates that display names are not synchronized
IsSyncNameAttr.description_zh: 是否同步显示名称。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步

IsSyncOuAsUserGroup.description_en: Indicates whether the organizational unit (OU) of a user is synchronized as a user group. A value of true indicates that the OU is synchronized. A value of false indicates that the OU is not synchronized
IsSyncOuAsUserGroup.description_zh: 是否将用户所在组织同步为用户组。取值：true表示同步，false表示不同步

MobileMapping.description_en: The field name that corresponds to the user mobile number on the AD server
MobileMapping.description_zh: AD服务器上对应的用户手机号的字段名称

NameMapping.description_en: The field name that corresponds to the username on the AD server
NameMapping.description_zh: AD服务器上对应的用户名称的字段名称

ServerName.description_en: The name of the AD authentication server

StandbyServer.description_en: The address of the standby server

SyncInterval.description_en: The interval at which user snapshots are automatically synchronized. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 and 4 to 168. A value of 0 indicates that automatic synchronization is disabled
SyncInterval.description_zh: 自动同步用户快照的间隔时间，单位为小时。取值为0或4～168，0表示不自动同步

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
